player_prompt.intro:
I nɛ Jokelani {player_id}. I bɛ tɛmɛ Sɛbɛnni Lamɛn.
I kɛra sɛbɛnni kɔnɔ {min_number} ani {max_number} cɛjɛ {max_turns} kɛlɛbɛw dɔ.
O kɔfɛ, jɛkulu bɛ na i yɛrɛ kɔnɔ 'sɛgɛsɛ' wa 'tɛmɛ'.
I bɛna kɔnɔ yɛrɛ kɛlɛbɛ. Sɛbɛnni kɛlɛbɛ bɛ yɛrɛ kɔnɔ masakɛ [ ] dɔ. Sɛbɛnni, [5].
O jɛkulu, i yɛrɛ kɔnɔ tɛmɛ bɛ sɔrɔ kɔnɔ. I bɛ sɛbɛnni kɔnɔ kɛlɛbɛ dɔ kɔfɛ i bɛ kɛra.
Kɔ i yɛrɛ kɔnɔ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Dɔnni dɔnkɛcogo kɛlɛbɛ. Jokelani {player_id} ma yɛrɛ kɔnɔ '[number]' kɛlɛbɛ.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Invalid move. Player {player_id} guessed a number outside the range specified.
invalid_move.already_guessed: Invalid move. Player {player_id} has already guessed the number.
